application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2103(GA)201  Received:  06 April 2021
2103(GA)001 (Rev A); 2103(GA)101  Received:  24 March 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be used for purposes incidental to the house's residential use only and not include kitchen, bathroom or bedroom functions, or be converted into a self-contained house or office used by a registered company, including those with non-resident employees and visitors.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be constructed with timber shiplap boardings, grey GRP roofing membrane with aluminium trims and grey powder coated casements only.
